## Executive Summary & Background
Abimael Firstana is an applied Data Analyst and Systems Builder specializing in transforming complex operational datasets into repeatable, high-confidence automated decision systems. Core strengths span end-to-end analytical engineering, statistical modeling, machine learning pipelines, and robust workflow automation.

## Technical Competencies & Tool Stack

- **Data Analytics & BI**: SQL (PostgreSQL, SQLite, BigQuery), Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling), Statistical Hypothesis Testing, EDA, Cohort & Retention Analysis.
- **Machine Learning & Modeling**: Python (Scikit-Learn, Pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, LightGBM), Classification, Clustering, TF-IDF / NLP, Cross-Validation Pipelines, Model Governance.
- **Automation & System Engineering**: Python GUI Automation (PyQt, Tkinter), Report Automation, ETL Scripts, REST API Ingestion, Desktop Executables.
- **Methodologies & Standards**: CRISP-DM, SKKNI BNSP (Indonesian National Work Competency Standards), Agile/Scrum, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Zero Data Leakage Invariants.

## Directory of 9 Technical Project Case Studies

1. **Banking Transaction Anti-Fraud Engine**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/projects/banking-transaction-anti-fraud/
   - Domain: Fintech & Fraud Risk Engineering
   - Stack: Python, Scikit-Learn, LightGBM, Streamlit, SHAP, Imbalanced-Learn
   - Impact: Intercepted \$420k+ in high-risk fraudulent transactions; achieved 0.94 ROC-AUC and 89% recall with <2.5% false positive rate under severe class imbalance (0.17%).

2. **Global Cancer Epidemiology Surveillance**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/projects/global-cancer-epidemiology-surveillance/
   - Domain: Healthcare Analytics & Global Epidemiology
   - Stack: Python, Pandas, SciPy, Plotly, Statistical Diagnostics
   - Impact: Uncovered epidemiological paradox across 185 territories; analyzed age-standardized mortality ratios (ASMR) and healthcare accessibility correlations ($p < 0.001$).

3. **Olist E-Commerce Logistics Analysis**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/projects/olist-e-commerce-logistics-analysis/
   - Domain: Logistics & Supply Chain Optimization
   - Stack: Power BI, DAX, Python, Spatial Geolocation Analysis
   - Impact: Evaluated 100k Brazilian e-commerce orders; identified cross-state freight bottlenecks, reducing estimated delivery lead-time by 3.4 days in high-friction corridors.

4. **Olist Payment Behavior Analytics**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/projects/olist-payment-behavior-analytics/
   - Domain: Consumer Fintech & Payment Behavioral Dynamics
   - Stack: SQL, Python, Seaborn, Customer Clustering
   - Impact: Mapped credit card installment risk elasticities across voucher, boleto, and debit users; formulated basket-size optimization tactics for low-margin merchants.

5. **Brent Oil Market Dynamics & Geopolitical Shocks**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/projects/brent-oil-market-dynamics/
   - Domain: Commodity Macroeconomics & Quantitative Finance
   - Stack: Python, Statsmodels, ARIMA/GARCH, Time Series Diagnostics
   - Impact: Modeled 30+ years of Brent Crude spot pricing volatility; captured regime shifts during OPEC supply shocks and global macro drawdowns.

6. **Amazon Product Intelligence Dashboard**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/projects/amazon-product-intelligence/
   - Domain: Commercial Intelligence & Pricing Elasticity
   - Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Static Data Ingestion, Recharts
   - Impact: Analyzed 1,465 Amazon product records across discount percentages, customer sentiment ratings, and pricing bands with instant client-side execution.

7. **ML Product Mapping & Catalog Matching Engine**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/projects/ml-product-mapping-system/
   - Domain: Machine Learning Systems & Retail Catalog Operations
   - Stack: Python, Scikit-Learn, TF-IDF, Cosine Similarity, RapidFuzz
   - Impact: Automated cross-catalog SKU matching across supplier price lists; lifted SKU mapping accuracy from 62% to 94.8% and reduced manual categorization cycle by 85%.

8. **Revenue Reconciliation Automation Engine**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/projects/revenue-reconciliation-automation/
   - Domain: Financial Operations Automation & Anomaly Detection
   - Stack: Python, Pandas, OpenPyXL, SQLite, Automated Audit Logging
   - Impact: Automated cross-validation between payment gateway settlement files and internal ERP ledger records; slashed daily reconciliation time from 3 hours to 4 minutes (45x acceleration).

9. **Enterprise Certificate Generator Desktop App**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/projects/certificate-generator-desktop-app/
   - Domain: Enterprise Productivity & Document Systems
   - Stack: Python, ReportLab, Pillow, Tkinter, PyInstaller
   - Impact: Batch rendered 5,000+ custom high-resolution credentials from raw Excel rosters in under 2 minutes with zero layout deformation.

## Directory of 4 Technical Architecture Essays

1. **The Epidemiological Paradox: Cancer Aging vs. Survival**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/opinion/the-epidemiological-paradox-cancer-aging-vs-survival/
   - Thesis: Why higher cancer incidence rates in developed economies reflect diagnostic capability and demographic aging rather than pure epidemiological failure.

2. **Why Dashboards Fail to Drive Decisions**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/opinion/why-dashboards-fail-to-drive-decisions/
   - Thesis: How metric vanity and passive reporting degrade executive action, and why threshold-driven exception reporting outperforms dense operational scorecards.

3. **The Vanity Metric Trap in E-Commerce**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/opinion/the-vanity-metric-trap-in-ecommerce/
   - Thesis: Deconstructing Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) vs net margin, return fraud friction, and sustainable unit economics in marketplace operations.

4. **Pragmatic Engineering: Simple Tools vs. Bloated Stacks**
   - URL: https://helloabimael.vercel.app/opinion/pragmatic-engineering-simple-tools-vs-bloated-stacks/
   - Thesis: The case for lean relational databases, modular Python utilities, and static frontends over over-engineered microservice architectures.
